posts.text:
I’m encouraging the Trump Administration to hold the line on refiner exemptions and protect homegrown biofuels. 
 
Biofuels save consumers money at the pump, help clean up the environment, and are great for farmers and ranchers. Rumors of giving refiners more exemptions will hurt our economy, farmers, and consumers. 
 
We need to do more – not less – to support the American economy and agriculture community.
posts.summary: Opposes refiner exemptions, backs biofuels support

It was an honor to have U.S. Secretary of War @PeteHegseth in Nebraska on Monday.

posts.text:
Last week, I toured the Valentine National Wildlife Refuge. 

Following this year’s historic fires, ranchers shared that grazing access at the refuge was important for continued rebuilding efforts. I worked with State Senator Storer and the Trump Administration to make this possible. 

I will always support Nebraska farmers and ranchers.
posts.summary: Coordinated grazing access at wildlife refuge post-fires with Trump Administration

posts.text:
Last week, Wells Fargo announced a $1 million investment to expand construction education at @mccneb. They also announced funding for HomeWoven to build more homes in Omaha.

It was great to have Mike Rowe in town as well. The mikeroweWORKS Foundation is committed to building the next generation of American skilled workers.

These partnerships will strengthen workforce development and expand housing options for Nebraskans!

posts.text:
It was a pleasure to host @SecRollins  and @SenatorFischer at my third annual Federal Issues Forum this week.

There is no better place than the Nebraska State Fair to talk about how we are fighting to protect the Good Life for every Nebraskan.

Nebraska producers are the best in the business. I will keep working to ensure that federal policies put our farmers and ranchers first. Agriculture is more than what we do, it’s our way of life.
